meta.title: Counter offer on a Global Field
gaps: Select a global field in the counter-offer dialog
Enter a new value for the global field and send that field-specific counter offer
Verify the global field shows the original value and counter value as highlighted
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Select a global field in the counter-offer dialog; Enter a new value for the global field and send that field-specific counter offer; Verify the global field shows the original value and counter value as highlighted

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Master QCS containing a vendor bid.
Use the available counter-offer flow as the closest supported action for sending the offer.
Assert that the buyer-side grid marks the vendor's bid as having a counter offer initiated.
Verify the expected pending counter-offer tag is visible above the vendor's name.
Check for the success feedback associated with sending the counter offer.
